plan.title: Closed RFQ withdrawal with spaces-only reason

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ event instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid setting.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing setting.
Reach the RFQ Responses view described by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Withdraw to open the withdrawal dialog.

args.label: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Enter exactly five spaces as the withdrawal reason.
Submit the withdrawal dialog after entering the spaces-only reason.
Record whether the withdrawal dialog remains or another result, including any visible validation message, appears.
Assert that the resulting screen is rendered without a crash or server error.
